game_name: Super Street Fighter II: The Tournament Battle (Japan 931005)
general_issues: Select ssf2tbj.zip; keep parent archives, keys and required qsound.zip beside it. Experimental emulation; profile coverage does not mean full gameplay qualification. Press Test to release the startup Test switch when navigating a boot-time operator screen. TPO automatically assigns up to 4 computers. Tournament Battle uses linked cabinets with two local players each (eight players with four computers). Rollback uses a canonical two-frame input delay; every linked cabinet and serial queue is restored together. Offline EEPROM and manual cabinet settings are ignored during online play.
